description.p: Bitty is a BitTorrent client that cannot torrent without a VPN. The torrent engine runs inside an isolated network namespace with a firewall that allows only the VPN tunnel and the one server address needed to establish it. There is no default route out, so if the VPN drops the engine is stopped and the firewall would block it regardless.

ul.li: Add torrents by magnet link or torrent file, pause, resume, remove or delete with files
Connects through any OpenVPN configuration, automatically on launch
One speed cap for the whole app, manual or a percentage of your measured line speed
Minimises to the tray, with the icon colour following VPN status
Tears down the namespace, firewall rules and VPN process on quit
